name: Effect of Concentration on an Equilibrium
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: NCERT textbook portal; Class 11 equilibrium activity page to verify
educational_goal: Observe a reversible color change and relate it qualitatively to a change in reactant concentration.
safety_notes: Use teacher-prepared dilute solutions and goggles.
Do not perform with concentrated reagents.

scenes.description: Several labeled test tubes containing a colored equilibrium mixture are compared after controlled additions of solution.
scenes.image_url: PLACEHOLDER: add a license-reviewed equilibrium color-change photo

steps.description: Place equal portions of the equilibrium mixture into labeled test tubes.
steps.observation: Each tube begins with a comparable color.
steps.key_visual: Each tube begins with a comparable color.

scenes.description: Several labeled test tubes containing a colored equilibrium mixture are compared after controlled additions of solution.

steps.description: Add a measured amount of reagent to one tube and water to another comparison tube.
steps.observation: The tubes now have different concentrations of the reacting species.
steps.key_visual: The tubes now have different concentrations of the reacting species.

steps.description: Mix gently and compare the colors under the same lighting.
steps.observation: The equilibrium mixture shifts color after the concentration change.
steps.key_visual: The equilibrium mixture shifts color after the concentration change.

scenes.description: Several labeled test tubes containing a colored equilibrium mixture are compared after controlled additions of solution.

steps.description: Record the direction of the visible shift and identify the applied change.
steps.observation: The color change provides qualitative evidence of equilibrium adjustment.
steps.key_visual: The color change provides qualitative evidence of equilibrium adjustment.
